## Why visit

A strong choice for the cultural side of a pub visit: a snug and curved main room downstairs, with theatre and other activity upstairs. It gives a Salford outing a different purpose from simply finding the largest handpump count. The local house beer and changing cask keep the visit grounded in beer, while the events programme may supply a genuinely memorable evening if it fits your dates. Combine it with New Oxford and allow enough flexibility to stay if the room or performance appeals.
